name: House of Sharp
old_description: At House of Sharp, custom turnkey metal fabrication solutions has never been so accessible. With an in-house graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, a team of skilled fabricators, and a fully-outfitted metal shop, we have both the passion and expertise to turn your vision into reality. Whether working with other Kansas businesses or the public, we pride ourselves in offering a premiere customer experience, unbeatable craftsmanship, and products that not only meet, but exceed your wildest expectations.
about:
House of Sharp operates from a 4,000-square-foot shop in Mulvane, Kansas, just south of Wichita. The company was founded in January 2018 by co-owners Ernest Sharp and Rose Hansen after Sharp built a CNC plasma table in the basement of a rental house and Hansen left her 9-to-5 job to pursue creative work.

The shop provides turnkey custom metal fabrication with an in-house team that includes a graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, and skilled fabricators. Capabilities span CNC plasma cutting, welding, and finishing to produce signs, railings, furniture, interior accents, gates, fences, bike racks, awards, and decorative screens. The facility includes a showroom and retail storefront.

Customers range from Kansas businesses to private individuals. Projects have included driveway arches for cemeteries, fireplace wraps for restaurants, patio railings for dining establishments, custom mailbox posts, and mixed-media pieces such as a steel-and-wood stool. The company also sells through an Etsy storefront.

Sharp and Hansen started the business to combine function and beauty, describing their motivation as passion, talent, creativity, and fun. They emphasize a collaborative customer experience that moves from concept through design to finished installation.
